title: DOMINION ENERGY, INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-08
summary: Dominion Energy, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 7-8, 2026 disclosing two credit facility extensions: an amendment extending its Sustainability Revolving Credit Agreement maturity to April 7, 2029, and lender consent to extend its Core Revolving Credit Agreement maturity to April 8, 2031. This is a corporate financing disclosure unrelated to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Dominion Energy amended its Sustainability Revolving Credit Agreement, extending maturity to April 7, 2029
The amendment allows up to two additional one-year extension options subject to conditions
Lenders consented to extend the Core Revolving Credit Agreement maturity to April 8, 2031
The Core Revolving Credit Agreement originally dated April 8, 2025
